as_told.title: Marcos Vinícius showed his alien video on a CD at home

plain: In Varginha, Brazil, a doctor named Marcos Vinícius had a video of the being said to have been treated at the town's regional hospital in 1996, and he showed it to many people at his house. The surgeon Italo Venturelli, who worked at that hospital, says visitors would come in, sit on the sofa, and watch it on his colleague's computer, which he thinks played it from a CD, sometimes over and over. If true, footage of the creature was passed around town among people who saw it with their own eyes.
